SH-01:
Motion · tab bar
A tab switch cross-fades the content (250 ms) and the selected pill slides to the new tab on the release spring (350 ms, slight overshoot). Each tab keeps its stack and scroll. Content scrolls under the glass bar; the bar never moves. Reduce Transparency: glass turns solid, nothing else changes.
SH-02:
Motion · Home · Strive 1+2
Start Push A: the button presses (scale .96, 100 ms), then the workout rises from the bottom as a full-screen sheet on the calm spring; Home stays behind it. Continue grows the minimised bar into the workout (350 ms). Cards appear without entrance animation: Home must feel instant.
Today done: the first time Home shows after Finish, the card's lime edge and ✓ pop once on the win spring (dampingRatio 0.45, stiffness 420). A full week plays once on This week (MO-week). Reduce Motion: colour only.
SH-03:
Motion · Start bubbles (choice 14c)
Tap Start: + rotates 45° to × (350 ms spring); the nearly clear panel scales from .6 out of Start (350 ms); the four bubbles spring out along the arc one after another, 40 ms apart, each from Start's centre (translate + scale .2 → 1). Labels fade in with their bubble. A tap outside or ×: everything returns to Start in reverse, 250 ms, no stagger. Reduce Motion: panel and bubbles fade in place (250 ms).
SH-04:
Motion · From template
The four bubbles shrink back into From template while the template grid fades and scales up from it (350 ms); Back reverses. The grid scrolls; its top row fades under the panel's edge.
SH-05:
Motion · Food
Static. The tab is a placeholder; filling it later moves nothing.
SH-06:
Motion · onboarding
Pages slide horizontally with the finger (paging, release spring); the dots stretch into the current one's capsule. Skip fades the onboarding out to Home (250 ms). The welcome art assembles once: the focus card, the week strip and the route line rise 12 pt and fade in, 40 ms apart.
SH-07:
Motion · hints
A hint fades in 400 ms after the screen settles, with a 6 pt rise; its arrow points at the control. Got it, or using the control, fades it out (250 ms). Each hint shows once.
SH-08:
Motion · permissions
Strive's explanation sheet rises on the release spring; Continue hands over to the system dialog (the system animates it). Denied: the screen shows its inline state without an alert.
WO-01:
Motion · empty workout
A quick pick presses, then the card collapses (height spring 350 ms) and the picked exercise unfolds in its place with the focus card above it; the chip row fades. Add exercises pushes the picker up as a full-height sheet.
WO-02:
Motion · logging (the signature moment) · Strive 1+2
✓ or Log set: press 100 ms (scale .96), then the ✓ fills and pops 1 → 1.14 → 1 on the win spring (dampingRatio 0.45, stiffness 420), a light haptic; the logged row's edge flashes lime 2 px and fades in 400 ms; the header's count rolls up. The tint slides to the next row and the rest card rises on the calm spring (design 1's, 350 ms); the focus card's values cross-fade (250 ms). (MO-log)
A record: six sun rays burst by the ✓ (300 ms), the sun toast drops from under the bar on the win spring and counts the value up in Unbounded (600 ms), a success haptic; it holds 2.5 s and leaves on the calm spring. (MO-record)
All logged: "14 of 14 sets" and the overview's n/n ✓ turn lime. Reduce Motion: cross-fades and colour only.
WO-03:
Motion · scrolled
As the large header leaves, the name and progress fade into the bar (250 ms) and the bar turns to glass. When the focus card leaves the view, the strip slides down from under the bar (350 ms) and fades in; scrolling back up slides it away. Tapping the strip scrolls to the card (spring scroll; Reduce Motion: jump).
WO-04:
Motion · dock
A tap on a set: the dock rises from the bottom on the release spring (350 ms) and the list stays put. The grabber follows the finger 1:1; released past a third of its height, or flicked down (> 1000 pt/s), it closes; otherwise it springs back. Log: press, the dock drops (250 ms), the row updates, the rest card rises. RIR 4+ opens its row with a height spring. Reduce Motion: fade in and out.
WO-05:
Motion · keypad
Tapping a field swaps the − and + for the keypad: the RIR/rest row collapses, the keys fade in from 8 pt below, 20 ms apart by row; the rest card hides (fade 150 ms). Next moves the teal ring to the next field (250 ms). Plates swap the digits for plate keys with a cross-fade; each plate key drops a plate onto the drawn sleeve (scale-in 200 ms).
WO-06:
Motion · rest timer · Strive 1+2
The ring drains in 1 s linear ticks; the digits change without animation (tabular figures). − / + nudge the ring on the calm spring. Last 3 s: the ring and digits stay teal and pulse 1.04 once a second. At 0: the ring closes and turns lime with the card's edge, popping on the win spring (dampingRatio 0.45, stiffness 420); sound, long buzz and a success haptic; "Rest over. Set 3 is yours." It holds about 600 ms, then settles 8 pt and fades (calm). Skip: fades at once. Reduce Motion: only the digits and colours change. (MO-rest)
WO-07:
Motion · menus
Pull-down menus scale from .96 at their anchor (transform-origin at the button) and fade in, 350 ms spring; a submenu slides in from the right within the menu (250 ms). A tap outside fades them (150 ms).
WO-08:
Motion · prompts
Alerts and prompts fade and scale from 1.05 to 1 (250 ms) over a scrim fading to 32 %. The keyboard is the system's.
WO-09:
Motion · exercise menu
As WO-07. Note opens today's note field under the header with a height spring and focuses it; Swap pushes the picker up as a sheet.
WO-10:
Motion · create superset
Picking a partner closes the dialog; the partner's block lifts out of the list and lands under the exercise (350 ms spring), the edge line draws down the pair (250 ms), the A/B tags fade in.
WO-11:
Motion · order and skip
↑ ↓ swap neighbours with a 350 ms spring; a superset moves as one block. Skip greys the row (250 ms).
WO-12:
Motion · exercise settings
A sheet rising on the release spring; values change in place.
WO-13:
Motion · set type
The badge's menu as WO-07. A set made a warm-up recolours (250 ms) and, if unlogged, lifts out and slides up to the next position (350 ms spring) while the rows between move down.
WO-14:
Motion · swipe to delete (O-20)
The row follows the finger 1:1, revealing red. Released short of 88 pt it springs back; between 88 pt and half the row it rests open on Delete; past half it keeps going: the red fills the row, Delete hugs the left, the row slides out (250 ms) and the rows below close up (350 ms spring), with a medium haptic. A swipe never counts as a tap.
WO-15:
Motion · finish sheet
The action sheet rises from the bottom (350 ms spring) over a scrim; a choice drops it (250 ms) and the summary pushes in from the right.
WO-16:
Motion · discard
As WO-08. Discard: the workout sheet slides down and away (350 ms) to where it started.
WO-17:
Motion · minimise (O-20)
⌄ or a drag down on the title bar: the workout shrinks into the bar above the tab bar, its frame morphing (350 ms spring), the tab bar fading back in. A drag past a third, or a flick, commits; otherwise it springs back. A tap on the bar grows it back. Reduce Motion: cross-fade. The bar's rest ring ticks like the card's.
WO-18:
Motion · notification
System-animated. The buzz and the sound come with it.
WO-19:
Motion · Live Activity
The countdown is a system timer (no per-second updates from the app). Ended: the ring swaps to a teal check with the system's content transition.
WO-20:
Motion · Dynamic Island
System-animated: compact ↔ expanded on long-press; the ring drains with the system timer.
WO-21:
Motion · summary · Strive 1+2
Pushes in from the right after Finish (calm). "Nailed it, Carl." fades in and rises 8 pt; the four tiles stagger in 50 ms apart on the win spring (dampingRatio 0.45, stiffness 420); the Records tile's sun edge glows once; the record stars pop in sequence. An exercise row expands with a height spring (calm). RPE segments fill on tap (100 ms). Reduce Motion: cross-fades only. (MO-finish)
WO-22:
Motion · update template
As WO-08. Update closes the summary back to where the workout started (slide down, 350 ms).
WO-23:
Motion · save as template
As WO-08; after Save, Plan's template row scrolls to the new card, which pulses its border once (teal, 600 ms).
WO-24:
Motion · session detail
Pushed from History (iOS push, 350 ms). Edit cross-fades the read-only rows into editable rows (250 ms).
WO-25:
Motion · editing
As the workout's rows and dock. Delete: alert, then pop back to History where the row collapses (350 ms).
WO-26:
Motion · History
The segmented control cross-fades the list (250 ms); week headers stick while their weeks scroll.
PL-01:
Motion · Plan
The week card's days swipe horizontally to the next week (paging spring); ‹ › do the same. A tapped day moves the teal selection (250 ms) and the day card below cross-fades to its plan. A template card zooms open into the full-screen preview (P1: the card's frame grows to the screen, 350 ms spring) and shrinks back on close. Deload now: the week's bar segment fills with D (250 ms).
PL-02:
Motion · Plan menus
As WO-07. Short week greys the dropped days (250 ms) without moving anything. Move to: the session lifts from its day and lands on the new day (350 ms spring).
PL-03:
Motion · template menu
As WO-07. Archive: the card shrinks and fades out of the row (250 ms), the cards close the gap (350 ms).
PL-04:
Motion · preview
The zoom from the card (PL-01). Start workout: the preview turns into the workout (cross-fade of the content, 250 ms).
PL-05:
Motion · template editor
As the workout's rows. Rows reorder by drag (lift: scale 1.02 + shadow; drop: 350 ms spring). Discard changes: the sheet slides away.
PL-06:
Motion · range keypad
As WO-05. Same for the rest: the copied values flash teal on each row below, 40 ms apart.
PL-07:
Motion · archived
Restore: the row slides out (250 ms); the template reappears in Plan's row.
PL-08:
Motion · programme weeks
A week row opens with a height spring (350 ms); the open week's days fade in 20 ms apart. Choosing Deload re-colours the row's miniature (250 ms).
PL-09:
Motion · weights
Static list; tab switches cross-fade (250 ms).
PL-10:
Motion · log
A new note slides in at the top (350 ms).
PL-11:
Motion · settings
Inline pickers open with a height spring.
PL-12:
Motion · create programme
A full-height sheet rising on the release spring; menus as WO-07.
EX-01:
Motion · library
Search filters live (no animation, results replace in place). A chip fills teal (100 ms) and the list cross-fades. Muscle headings stick while their group scrolls. A row pushes exercise detail (iOS push).
EX-02:
Motion · filter sheet
Rises on the release spring; the list behind updates live as chips toggle.
EX-03:
Motion · picker
A tick fills the circle (100 ms) and the glass bar's counts update; Add drops the sheet and the new exercises slide into the workout, 40 ms apart.
EX-04:
Motion · swap
A tap swaps the name in the workout with a cross-fade; the sets stay.
EX-05:
Motion · exercise detail
The segmented control cross-fades the four parts (250 ms). From the workout it is a sheet with a grabber (release spring), so the workout stays under it.
EX-06:
Motion · history
Cards push the session detail.
EX-07:
Motion · chart
A tap moves the teal selection to the nearest point (150 ms) and writes its value into the title; a second tap pushes that workout. Period changes re-draw the line (300 ms).
EX-09:
Motion · create exercise
A full-height opaque sheet (release spring); each row's pull-down as WO-07; Save enables (fade 150 ms) once a name and a primary muscle exist.
RU-01:
Motion · run start
The GPS state cross-fades from searching (a spinner) to ready (teal dot, a light haptic). Start run: a 3-2-1 count in the big type (1 s each, Reduce Motion: no count, starts at once) and the live screen slides up.
RU-02:
Motion · live run
The big number updates without animation. A tap cycles distance → time → pace → avg pace with a vertical cross-fade (200 ms). The map panel follows the finger and swipes away (release spring); the numbers grow to fill the space (350 ms). Lap: a banner drops for 3 s with a haptic.
RU-03:
Motion · paused
The numbers dim to 40 % and Paused pulses once (no loop). Resume and Finish replace Pause and Lap with a cross-fade.
RU-05:
Motion · run summary · Strive 1+2
The route draws itself once (800 ms ease-out), then the stats sheet rises over the map's lower half (calm) while the distance rolls 0 → 8.04 km (700 ms) and a lime check pops by the title on the win spring (dampingRatio 0.45, stiffness 420). A run with records: the records card's sun edge glows once and its stars pop. The sheet scrolls up over the map into the sections. Reduce Motion: cross-fades only. (MO-finish)
RU-06:
Motion · sections
Tapping a chart moves a cursor along distance and shows the value at that point; a split row highlights (150 ms).
RU-07:
Motion · full map
The map expands from the summary's map (350 ms). Map types cross-fade (250 ms); 3D tilts the camera (600 ms ease-in-out).
RU-08:
Motion · flyover
The camera follows the route at 1x real speed scaled to 30 s for the whole run; the scrubber drives it. Reduce Motion: the flyover is replaced by the route drawing itself in 2D.
RU-09:
Motion · edit run
A sheet rising on the release spring.
EL-01:
Motion · You
Rows push their screens (iOS push).
EL-02:
Motion · Progress · Strive 1+2
The total counts up once (800 ms) in Unbounded and the curve draws left to right. A tap on the comparison line cross-fades to the next line (250 ms), a light haptic. One rule: a tap shows the next, in the list's order, looping; never on a timer, nowhere but Progress (EL-02-cmp). Period changes re-draw the bars from the baseline (calm spring, 20 ms stagger). A tapped bar turns teal and its value appears above it.
EL-04:
Motion · main lifts
Ticks fill (100 ms); past five, the rest dim (250 ms).
EL-05:
Motion · profile
Fields edit in place; no motion.
EL-06:
Motion · settings
Grouped list; menus as WO-07; switches slide their knob on the release spring.
EL-07:
Motion · plates and bars
As EL-06.
EL-08:
Motion · devices
Linking shows a spinner in the row; Linked cross-fades in with a light haptic.
EL-09:
Motion · Health
Link hands over to the system sheet.
EL-10:
Motion · gear
Rows push detail; Retire slides the row into Retired.
EL-11:
Motion · gear detail
A sheet for new gear; a push for existing gear.
EL-12:
Motion · choose shoes
A sheet; the tick moves (150 ms).
EL-13:
Motion · export
Share… shows the spinner inside the button (the label cross-fades to Exporting…), then the system share sheet rises.
EL-15:
Motion · import (later)
The progress bar fills linearly; done cross-fades to the check.
EL-16:
Motion · sync (later)
The sync glyph turns while syncing (the one loop allowed: it ends when the work does).
EL-17:
Motion · food (later)
Rings fill once on open (600 ms).
EL-18:
Motion · log food (later)
As the library's search.
O-22:
Motion · activity (later)
The Activity bubble joins the arc as the fifth, same stagger.
